name: dev-conventions
description: Development conventions in three tiers: a PreToolUse hook blocks pip in uv projects, npm/yarn/pnpm in bun projects, and hand-edited lockfiles; a small SessionStart directive carries only the preferences no hook can enforce; skills hold what Claude cannot derive. Per-repo overrides live in a tracked .dev-conventions.json -- disable a block or add house rules with /dev-conventions:configure.
